why: Verify desktop Metal renderer and distinguish game timing from browser cadence while keeping failed shutdown visible.
verdict: not accepted as a completed performance baseline
observations: Apple M3 Pro Metal renderer confirmed in headed Chromium.
Four 60-second phases each restore exact checkpoints; median gaps 33.3 ms and p95 34.2 ms, but browser shutdown timed out.
A short repeat closed successfully. Another short repeat had median 8.3 ms/p95 9.3 ms in all phases but shutdown timed out.
Empty visible focused page showed median 8.8 ms/p95 34.1 ms. This supports non-game pacing variability but does not establish its cause.
Detaching the memory-sampling CDP session is explicit now, but did not reliably resolve shutdown.
Benchmark success message moved after cleanup so a timeout cannot follow a premature PASS.
limits: Failed-cleanup measurements remain diagnostic observations, not passing runs.
No visual acceptance from these retained report files; screenshots remain local, not newly reviewed here.
No physical display pacing, hardware 60fps baseline or sustained RSS plateau acceptance.
next: Investigate owned-browser shutdown, retaining bounded failure reporting.
